title.narrative: Sindh Coastal Resilience Integrated Programme (SCRIP) with Aga Khan Foundation (AKF), Pakistan

description.narrative:
The project, to be implemented in priority districts of Thatta and Suajjawal will improve coastal communities’ resilience to climate change and their ability to adapt and mitigate climate risks and has the following objectives:
1) Strengthened local capacity for disaster preparedness, coastal resilience planning, and knowledge and coping capacities 2) Improved management of Mangroves by target communities through resilient and sustainable solutions
Key interventions will include a foundation mapping and needs assessment, development of coastal resilience plans, deploying disaster mitigation and adaptation solutions, community bases disaster risk management, improving marine-based livelihood opportunities, promoting regenerative farming, provision of clean energy solutions, and improvements in water, sanitation and hygiene through targeted WASH infrastructure support.
